caption: Veterans Guardian VA Claim Consulting LLC v. Platkin
citation_line: Veterans Guardian VA Claim Consulting LLC v. Platkin, No. 24-1097 (3d Cir. Apr. 1, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Shipp denied preliminary relief against a New Jersey law restricting compensation for advice and assistance concerning veterans-benefit claims, reasoning that the law regulated conduct rather than protected speech.
qualification_rationale: The case concerns the First Amendment status of paid professional advice, the regulation of a nationwide veterans-benefits consulting industry, and the constitutional distinction between regulating the price of services and burdening speech itself.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit vacated and remanded in a precedential opinion. It held that paid claims advice likely constitutes protected speech and directed separate analysis of the law’s distinct restrictions under the proper First Amendment framework.
